title: P8: rule lens — rules as subobjects with resolution policy (HYPOTHESIZED)
description: Phase 8 of docs/DESIGN.md §4.4. Rule presentation over the input domain X: rules as decidable predicates (subobjects R_i), policy = order-enrichment (PriorityOrder/FirstMatch/DeclaredDisjoint), effective region E_i = R_i \ u_{j<i} R_j. Findings: gap (uR_i != X), overlap (intersection without policy), shadow (E_i empty), derivable (R_k = R_i AND R_j). Equivalence-checkable simplification via distinguish (same total action on X, witness inputs otherwise). Rule discovery: examples + predicate vocabulary, partition-equivalence check. Attribute columns + decidable expression language (int/bool/string comparisons, AND/OR/NOT, mod) enter the kernel here. Epistemic status HYPOTHESIZED: precedent above the floor (Rust exhaustiveness, DMN hit policies) but no ct-catlab-class evidence. RED: no rule presentation type; findings not expressible. GREEN: gap/overlap/shadow/derivable findings on an enumerable domain are exact via P4 bounded search; distinguish proves or refutes rule-table equivalence with witnesses. REFACTOR: predicate expression language scoped to decidability; presentation JSON in model document. Validation (pre-registered): one kata ABOVE the triviality floor (10-20 compound rules + priority policy, pricing/eligibility table) + one second negative control NEAR the floor; killed if no unique detections above the floor. GATED on P6 (catherine-9vv) recording the schema-lens negative control first.
